wnba.Headline: Stewart after USA's FIBA World Cup title: 'Our goal is always gold'
wnba.Description: Stewart after USA's FIBA World Cup title: 'Our goal is always gold'

wnba.Headline: How Team USA rallied to beat France and win World Cup gold
wnba.Description: France led by 14 points early, but the U.S. defense dominated and veterans stepped up to capture a fifth straight gold.

wnba.Headline: U.S. beats France for fifth straight women's World Cup title
wnba.Description: Team USA largely credited Breanna Stewart for helping guide them to the program's fifth straight World Cup title after a win over France in the final.

wnba.Headline: Spain beats Germany to win bronze at women's FIBA World Cup
wnba.Description: Iyana Martín led Spain to the bronze medal at the women's FIBA World Cup with an 81-58 win over host Germany.

wnba.Headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: USA-France gold medal game preview
wnba.Description: It's the World Cup finale fans wanted to see: Team USA and France will meet in a rematch of the Olympic gold medal game.

wnba.Headline: U.S. tops Spain, gears up for FIBA final vs. France in '24 Olympic rematch
wnba.Description: The U.S. pulled away in a 76-66 win over Spain while France routed Germany on Saturday, setting up a highly anticipated clash in Sunday's FIBA World Cup final.

wnba.Headline: France tops host Germany to reach FIBA World Cup final
wnba.Description: Gabby Williams had 22 points and five rebounds to lead France to the final of the women's FIBA World Cup with a win over host Germany.

wnba.Headline: Team USA hears coach's message entering FIBA World Cup semis
wnba.Description: As Team USA gears up for the FIBA World Cup semifinals, it feels it is poised to play its best basketball because of how coach Kara Lawson has challenged its players.

wnba.Headline: Fever's Sophie Cunningham not worried about off-court distractions
wnba.Description: Sophie Cunningham says she is focusing on the Fever's remaining games and not the commotion around Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White declaring for the WNBA draft.

wnba.Headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: Team USA and semifinal preview
wnba.Description: The FIBA Women's World Cup semifinal matchups are set. How does each team stack up going into Saturday's games?

wnba.Headline: Storm's Ezi Magbegor suffers torn ACL at women's FIBA World Cup
wnba.Description: Seattle Storm forward Ezi Magbegor will miss the remainder of the WNBA season after suffering a torn ACL while playing for Australia at the women's FIBA World Cup in Germany.

wnba.Headline: How do the WNBA playoffs work? Dates, format and more
wnba.Description: The 2026 WNBA playoffs begins on Sept. 27. Learn more about postseason dates, rules, and stats now.

wnba.Headline: Team USA scores 108 in rout of Hungary to reach FIBA semis
wnba.Description: The U.S. routed Hungary 108-56 to advance to the semifinals of the women's FIBA World Cup and stretched its winning streak in the tournament to 34 games.

wnba.Headline: Nigeria 'weren't there yet' after FIBA Women's World Cup exit - Rena Wakama
wnba.Description: The Nigerian women ended their campaign with a 111-56 loss to France on Monday, their third defeat in as many Group B games after opening with a 99-81 loss to South Korea and then falling 71-67 to Hungary.

wnba.Headline: Angel Reese, Caitlin Clark having 'fun' playing together for U.S.
wnba.Description: Angel Reese and Caitlin Clark's interactions are a subplot of the women's FIBA World Cup and the WNBA season, but Clark says many of the stories about their relationship are "false takes," saying she loves the fiery competitiveness that they share.

wnba.Headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: Team USA and quarterfinal preview
wnba.Description: The U.S. women and France remain front-runners as the knockout stage arrives in Berlin, but who else has impressed?

wnba.Headline: USA eyes more consistency vs. Hungary at FIBA World Cup
wnba.Description: USA coach Kara Lawson is hoping her team can improve with each round of the FIBA World Cup, beginning with Thursday's quarterfinal game vs. Hungary.

wnba.Headline: WNBA  playoffs schedule 2026: Dates released for postseason
wnba.Description: The first round of the 2026 WNBA playoffs opens on Sept. 27. The semifinals tip Oct. 4 and the Finals open Oct. 17.

wnba.Headline: Germany beats South Korea, rolls into World Cup quarterfinals
wnba.Description: Host Germany advanced to the quarterfinals of the women's FIBA World Cup with a morale-boosting 94-56 rout of South Korea on Tuesday, and the United States learned its next opponent.

wnba.Headline: Potential WNBA commissioner candidates to succeed Cathy Engelbert
wnba.Description: Executives from the WNBA, NBA and Nike are among potential candidates to succeed Cathy Engelbert when she retires.
